summary: Execution chain step A done: the SCK unit tests were actually run for the first time and all 7 pass. sck-head-v1.json now records executed_passing instead of written_not_run.
round_goal: Run the existing SCK unit tests and fix any import, numerical, belief, planner, adapter or evaluation failure before adding new features.
changed: runtime/adaptation/storybox/sck-head-v1.json: status sck_v0_implemented_tests_written_not_run -> sck_v0_tests_executed_passing; runtime.tests_status executed_passing; added test_command and test_evidence; next_gate no longer asks for a first test run.
.gitignore: ignore the .venv-textarena environment used for live TextArena runs.
findings: The SCK tests are pytest-style functions, not unittest.TestCase classes. 'python -m unittest discover -s tests' reports 'NO TESTS RAN' for them, so HANDOFF.md's documented command cannot verify this component. The working command is recorded in sck-head-v1.json.
'python -m unittest discover -s tests' also hung for over two minutes without output in this container, so it is not a usable baseline here.

Under pytest, full-suite collection fails on tests/test_reverie_micro_bridge_v6.py and tests/test_storybox_ensemble_driver_v7.py: both import reverie modules that require sqlalchemy, which is not installed. So HANDOFF.md's '86 unittest passed' number is not reproducible in a dependency-free interpreter; it can only be reproduced with the full pyproject dependency set.
limits: Only the SCK-scoped tests were verified. The 86-test full-suite claim was not reproduced and is not claimed here.
No SCK source change was required, so this round proves the existing tests pass; it does not yet prove SCK produces better play.
next_gate: Execution chain step B: implement an information-safe TextArena SecretMafia live runner that consumes only actor-visible observations and can complete a full episode.
action_required: No reply needed. Recorded so the next driver can trust tests_status=executed_passing and use the recorded command instead of unittest discover.
